versions.changelog: v1.2.1: ClawHub security audit remediation. (1) Fixed command-injection in archive-template.md: user-provided novel title is now sanitized via allowlist (tr -cd '[:alnum:] _.-') and all path expansions are quoted (previously unquoted [小说标题] interpolation could be shell-injected). (2) Added Operation Risk & Safety Rules section: confirm scope before archive, verify destination stays inside archive root, prefer file tools over shell. (3) Tightened archive triggers to explicit user commands only; vague phrasing no longer counts. (4) Stage 13 'archive v0' now requires explicit user confirmation (resolves contradiction with read-only-archive policy). (5) Reverse-merge now requires confirmation + backup warning (resolves read-only vs overwrite contradiction). (6) Added language note: docs are Chinese (Chinese web-novel domain), output language follows the project; English README available.

v1.2.0: SKILL.md frontmatter 补全（name/version/license/中英 description/compatibility/allowed-tools）；新增 references/lifecycle.md（13 阶段完整流程详情）与 references/name-rules.md（命名规则表）；修正子文件表死链（lifecycle/name-rules 此前引用但缺失）；新增 LICENSE（BSD 3-Clause）与 VERSION 文件；README/README.zh 文件表与版本记录同步。
Removed unsupported license field from SKILL.md frontmatter (ClawHub CLI v0.8.0 defaults to MIT-0 regardless; BSD-3-Clause license text preserved in README).
Fixed license field from BSD-3-Clause to MIT.
Initial release: 13-phase novel workflow, global chapter numbering, read-only archives, HTML guides, character JSON export, bilingual README (100k-1.5M words proven at 420k words).
